entries.text: The passage of time in prisons is not in a cell of brick and mortar but in one of hopes dashed and tragedies unaverted. How precious, then, the chance to go back only to discover that in facing the past you must face up to yourself... That exiting the prison of time doesn't free you from the prison of your own character... One from which there is no escape.
entries.speaker: Martin Wells
